# GreenCube

> GreenCube is a private AI app for Windows that runs entirely on your own computer. Your conversations, documents and images never leave your machine. One payment of €9.99 — no subscription, no usage limits.

GreenCube runs an AI model locally on your own hardware instead of on a company's servers. Because the model runs on your machine, there is no server that receives, stores, reads or trains on your conversations. It works fully offline after a one-time sign-in and model download.

## What it does

- **Chat & write** — ask anything, draft anything; answered on your own machine
- **Read your documents** — drop in a PDF and it reads the whole thing, summarises and explains it
- **Understand images** — show it a photo or screenshot and it interprets what's there
- **Make study material** — turn a chat into flashcards, a quiz, a table or a clean write-up
- **Build a small web page** — a revision poster, flip-cards, a calculator: asked for in the chat, and it runs offline like everything else

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Tiers: GreenCube reads the machine it is installed on and sorts it into one of four tiers, which set its defaults. Seed (~8 GB, no graphics card), Sprout (16 GB or more, no graphics card), Bloom (a real graphics card with 4 GB or more), Thrive (a strong card with 8 GB or more alongside 24 GB or more of memory)
- Memory decides how much fits; a graphics card decides how fast it runs. That is why a card moves a machine further up the list than extra memory does, and why 32 GB with no card is still Sprout: the extra memory widens the context window rather than speeding up the words
- Every tier gets unlimited answers, document reading, flashcards, quizzes, tables and real PowerPoint files. Only model-written slide decks, web pages, image handling and reply continuation differ by tier
- No tier costs more than another: all four are the same app at the same one-time price. Every capability a tier switches off is overridable in Settings (Auto / On / Off), so a limit is always a default and never a cap
- Price: €9.99 (US$9.99), one-time payment. No subscription, no recurring fees, no usage limits
- Works fully offline after the first sign-in and model download
- The sign-in only confirms purchase; it never receives conversations, documents or images
- An optional Offline/Online switch enables live web search. It is off by default — only when switched on do searches reach the internet
- Honest limitation: large cloud models are more capable than a model that fits on a personal computer. GreenCube trades some capability for privacy and ownership
- Company: Edunexis SL
